component: UMa LOS and NLOS path loss
equation: PL_LOS = 28 + 22 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc) before breakpoint; PL_NLOS = max(PL_LOS, 13.54 + 39.08 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc) - 0.6(hUT-1.5))
parameter_domain: 0.5-100 GHz; d2D >= 10 m; hBS=25 m; hUT=1.5 m in this study
deviation: LOS state is sampled externally by the scenario generator; spatial consistency and full fast-fading clusters are custom/out of scope.
external_crosscheck: Validated against LLSim5G 1.0.0 at pinned commit 87ec64e0a9ed2c72384d046eabfa05071870f041

equation: PL_LOS = 28 + 22 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc); high-altitude NLOS uses the Table B-2 height-dependent term and max with LOS
parameter_domain: 2 GHz study configuration; UAV altitude 50-300 m
deviation: LOS state is sampled by a disclosed elevation-dependent probability; no full 3D cluster model.
external_crosscheck: Not applicable: LLSim5G's A2G path-loss implementation cites Khawaja et al. (2019), not TR 36.777; source-derived deterministic vector retained

equation: PL_basic = FSPL(d3D, fc) + explicitly supplied clutter loss
parameter_domain: S/Ku/Ka band configurations; persisted spherical-Earth slant range; elevation >= 10 degrees for availability
deviation: Only the basic path-loss component is attributed to TR 38.811. Mobility, random fading, outage, interference, MCS, and KPI mapping are separately documented custom components.
